### Action Rationale

Do not initiate until price pulls back to entry trigger. AUM extremely small — size entry carefully to avoid market impact.

- Price pullback to $19-20 range triggers entry gate — 2.5% initiation

### Risks

- AUM very small (~$245K per yfinance) — liquidity risk; large orders could move price
- IPGP (13.7%) is primarily industrial fiber lasers — limited AI data center exposure; dilutes thesis
- LASR (10.1%) is defense/industrial lasers — tangential to photonics thesis
- Sector has already re-rated 200-300% — multiple compression from current levels likely before thesis plays out
- Expense ratio ~0.85% (Tuttle Capital estimate) — meaningful drag at small AUM

### Entry Note

INITIATE at 2.5% target only on pullback to <$19. At $23.65 the entry gate has not been triggered. Monitor weekly — if COHR or LITE pull back sharply, FOTO will follow. GTC limit order at $18.90 is a reasonable set-and-forget approach.
